newsitem.title: USA: Anicom to sell preferred stock for $27 mln.
newsitem.headline: Anicom to sell preferred stock for $27 mln.

text.p: Anicom Inc said Wednesday it agreed in principle to sell about three million shares of convertible preferred stock in a private placement of approximately $27.0 million.
The shares are being sold to a group of institutional investors including Cahill, Warnock Strategic Partners Fund and Huizenga Capital Management.
Anicom said it expects to close this private placement in the next two weeks.
"We expect that this investment will enhance our ability to grow a strong and profitable company," Alan Anixter, chairman, said in a statement.
Anicom said proceeds will be used for ongoing acquisition opportunities as they arise and for general corporate purposes.
Commenting on the investment, David Warnock, managing member of Cahill, Warnock, said, "We have followed Anicom's recent acquisitions and growth in this highly fragmented industry."
Anicom sells and distributes multimedia technology products, including products used in Internet connections and the global communications industry.
Coopers & Lybrand Securities LLC was the financial advisor to Anicom in the transaction.
